# tuna_ip_policy_rule (Resource)

An allow/deny rule inside an IP policy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tuna_ip_policy" "office" {
  name = "office-only"
}

resource "tuna_ip_policy_rule" "office_allow" {
  ip_policy_id = tuna_ip_policy.office.id
  name         = "office"
  cidr         = "203.0.113.0/24"
  action       = "allow"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) Rule action: allow or deny.
- `cidr` (String) CIDR the rule applies to.
- `ip_policy_id` (Number) ID of the IP policy the rule belongs to.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the rule.
- `name` (String) Name of the rule.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Composite ID: <ip_policy_id>/<rule_id>
terraform import tuna_ip_policy_rule.office_allow 123/456
```
